rules.name: cs-12-bfa-funnel-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.security_id, d.premium AS traded_price, a.active_lots, CASE WHEN si.derivative_type IN ('future', 'cs_future') AND :valueDate > si.maturity_date THEN fp.last_price ELSE h.settle_price END AS settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN (SELECT x.trade_id, x.active_lots FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs x JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(value_date) AS value_date FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs WHERE value_date <= :valueDate GROUP BY trade_id) m ON m.trade_id = x.trade_id AND m.value_date = x.value_date) a ON a.trade_id = d.trade_id LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs cs ON cs.security_id = d.security_id LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.security_info_table_cfs si ON si.security_id = d.security_id LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs h ON h.security_id = d.security_id AND h.value_date = :valueDate LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.futures_price_table fp ON fp.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id AND fp.value_date = si.maturity_date WHERE d.contract_number LIKE 'BFA_CT%' AND d.transaction_date < :valueDate AND d.counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400' AND d.subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND ((cs.maturity_date IS NULL AND d.netting_status <> 'fully_netted') OR (d.netting_status = 'fully_netted' AND d.netting_date > :valueDate) OR (:valueDate <= cs.maturity_date AND d.netting_status IN ('not_netted', 'partially_netted')))

SELECT c.trade_id, c.contract_number, d.security_id, c.traded_price, c.active_lots, c.settle_price FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.business_unit = c.business_unit AND d.trade_id = c.trade_id AND d.is_latest_version = 1 WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.contract_number LIKE 'BFA_CT%'

SELECT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, si.derivative_type, si.maturity_date, d.netting_status, d.netting_date, (SELECT count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.premium_fy_table_cfs p WHERE p.trade_id = d.trade_id) AS premium_fy_rows, (SELECT max(p.financial_year) FROM dbsystemuat.premium_fy_table_cfs p WHERE p.trade_id = d.trade_id) AS last_financial_year FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.security_info_table_cfs si ON si.security_id = d.security_id WHERE d.contract_number LIKE 'BFA_CT%' AND d.transaction_date < :valueDate

END AS f) s ORDER BY p.contract_number, p.price
